articles.headline: Australian players slam FIFA plan as Football Australia waits for more info
articles.description: Football Australia says it was unaware of FIFA's plans to sell stakes in tournaments such as the FIFA World Cup, but has confirmed it will not form a position until further information and consultation are provided.

articles.headline: Ancelotti confirms Italy offer, insists he's committed to Brazil
articles.description: Carlo Ancelotti has confirmed he received an approach to coach his native Italy but said he turned down the role because he remains committed to leading Brazil.

articles.headline: World Cup for sale? FIFA's controversial plans explained
articles.description: FIFA's plan to raise up to $20 billion in private investment has been widely condemned. What is it all about? And, crucially, what will happen next?

articles.headline: FIFA opens assault case against Argentina trio over World Cup final
articles.description: FIFA has opened disciplinary proceedings for assault against Argentina players Leandro Paredes and Nahuel Molina and assistant coach Roberto Ayala over clashes with Spain players following the World Cup final.
